for_you.ask: Synthetic users run 3 (WS-142): test persona sub-agents on Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 before the run?

for_you.ask: Long sessions: one fresh session per wake for the conductor?
for_you.detail: Its task fires into one standing session, so cache reads grow each wake. A fresh session per wake resets that, but needs a new key each time.

friendly.title: Your agents' token use, 4 November
friendly.summary: Only one agent has reported so far. It did a big job in one very long session, and that long session is where most of the waste is. Four agents have been asked to start reporting.

numbers.label: Fresh tokens
numbers.explain: New work: reading, writing and thinking. The main cost.

numbers.label: Cache reads
numbers.explain: Re-reading what is already in memory. About a tenth of the price each, but they add up.

numbers.label: Agents reporting
numbers.explain: Synthetic has. Conductor, dev, dashboard and designer were asked today.

numbers.label: Saving per day
numbers.explain: Measured once you say yes to a change below.

friendly.bars_title: Where synthetic's tokens went (one long session)
friendly.bars_note: The long bar at the bottom is the problem: the longer a session runs, the more it re-reads on every step.

savings.title: Start fresh more often
savings.plain: One long session re-reads its whole history on every step. A new session for each run starts light.
savings.evidence: 125 steps, about 173,000 tokens re-read per step.

savings.title: Try a smaller model for helpers
savings.plain: The 12 persona helpers all ran on Opus 5.5, the largest model. Reading a card and giving a verdict may not need it.
savings.evidence: 111 helper steps, all Opus 5.5. Test first (decision A2).

savings.title: Give helpers a short brief
savings.plain: Each helper loaded its own large briefing. A short brief and a fixed answer form cut that.

decisions.question: Should every agent report its tokens after each run?
decisions.plain: One line added to the conductor's, dev's and dashboard's scheduled task. Without it there is nothing to measure.

decisions.question: Test cheaper models for the persona helpers before the next run?
decisions.plain: One persona on Sonnet 5.5 and one on Haiku 5.5, scored blind against Opus. Costs under 200,000 tokens, once.

decisions.question: Give the conductor a fresh session for each run?
decisions.plain: Cheaper, but each new session needs a new key. Better to measure three runs first.

glossary: a small piece of text, about four letters. Models are paid per token.
input, output and new memory written; the real work.
text the model already holds, read again; cheap one by one, costly in bulk.
